title: MorphoID: clean reproducibility code and regional data
description: Frozen MorphoID workflows, configurations, regional analysis inputs and provenance audits. Original code is MIT; source-derived data retain provider terms. No Phikon-v2 weights, embeddings, raw tissue images or private correspondence are bundled. Obtain raw data and the licensed encoder separately; consult LICENSE_SCOPE.md and docs/PHIKON_REGENERATION.md. Portable end-to-end reproduction has not been executed for this packaging update.
